verdict.rationale: Evidence shows SDKs (OAuth client, PHP SDK) and an MCP server referencing 'V3 REST API', implying versioning, but there is no documentation pack, changelog, or explicit deprecation policy for the API versions; probes even show openapi.json and llms.txt 404s, suggesting discoverability of API specs is weak. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning changelog, migration guides, sunset timelines.
